candidates.hypothesis: An extreme standardized 24-hour performance gap between Brent and WTI partially mean-reverts over the next 12 hours.
entry_conditions: Compute each market's 24-clock-hour return divided by its ATR14 at synchronized t.
Spread(t)=BrentNormalizedReturn-WTINormalizedReturn.
Z(t)=(Spread(t)-mean(Spread[t-120:t-1]))/sample_std(Spread[t-120:t-1]).
If Z>=2.00, SELL Brent and BUY WTI; if Z<=-2.00, BUY Brent and SELL WTI. Each leg is a separate episode sharing one cluster weight.
